sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for VOICES 2D pixel art game. Input reference is STYLE only, same cute chunky chibi proportions, big round head, tiny body, strong crisp dark outline, broad readable pixel clusters, not realistic, not smooth 3D. Create ONE BALD friendly androgynous young adult avatar wearing a plain short sleeved T shirt and long trousers. Warm brown skin, no hair, no hat, no eyewear, no other accessories. Clothes use saturated MAGENTA #e000c8 for the top garment and bright CYAN #00bdd2 for lower garment, with darker shades of the same hues; these two material colors must never appear on skin. Shoes and outlines dark neutral. Bald head and face consistent in every frame, no background. Exact grid FOUR columns by SIX rows, equal square cells, all full body sprites centered and feet aligned on same baseline in each cell, empty gutters, no text, no labels, no guides, no effects. Row 1: facing camera, four successive WALK cycle frames. Row 2: facing LEFT profile, four walk frames. Row 3: facing RIGHT profile, four walk frames. Row 4: facing AWAY back view, four walk frames. Row 5: facing camera, four simple arm gesture/action poses with head staying upright at the same height. Row 6: facing camera, four happy celebration poses arms raised, head stays at same height. Every sprite exactly same height and scale, no frames cropped. Square cell registration is essential. All figures bald, no shadows on the ground. Transparent background. Overall canvas portrait 2:3 ratio, 4 by 6 cells.
